title.zh: Player5 与 GPT-6 Astra 16:16 握手言和
title.en: Player5 and GPT-6 Astra share the win at 16–16

desc.zh: 全场 51 球。Astra 半场以 10:7 领先，Player5 第 177 回合最多落后 4 分，随后反超；Astra 第 393 回合扳平，终场 16:16。
desc.en: 51 captures in all. Astra led 10–7 at halftime and Player5 was down by 4 on turn 177 before going ahead. Astra equalised on turn 393 and it finished 16–16.
